method.scope: instrumented native-helper extraction queue including helper startup, filesystem reads, content SHA-256, writes, fsync and Python queue dispatch/pipe-pump overhead
method.cacheRegime: warmed OS/filesystem caches; before-batch streaming input prehash warms all source bytes. No global purge or cold-cache claim
method.cpu: sum of exact owned helper wait4 user/system CPU
method.diskCounters: wait4 block operations, NOT byte counts; unavailable/zero counters do not imply zero disk I/O
method.workerMeaning: maximum concurrent single-job helper processes, not threads or production app policy
method.retention: delete only exact newly created, independently verified export files after each batch

nativeBuild.linking: static libtsk + libewf, header-only nlohmann/json; system-only dynamic libraries

sanitization: Omitted absolute paths, output identities and per-job process objects; preserved batch measurement receipts and synthetic provenance. Source revision is the base commit; recipe digests identify the working-tree harness used.

rssSampler.limitations: RSS summed across exact live owned helper PIDs. Samples read PIDs sequentially, not atomically; short jobs/peaks can be missed. Sampler/queue overhead is present in all instrumented batches. Parent, GUI and non-owned processes are excluded.
